summaryZh: Mueller 实验室研究植物根与土壤真菌间的丛枝菌根共生。重点是植物如何在分子层面控制共生的启动与维持；具体方法未明确。
researchQuestions: 植物控制菌根共生启动与维持的分子基础是什么？

evidence.quote: We study a mutually beneficial relationship between plant roots and soil fungi called arbuscular mycorrhiza symbiosis. More specifically, we study the molecular basis of plant control over symbiosis initiation and maintenance.
